elements_selected.content: Implement wikilink parsing and anchor glyph injection for the main pane. For each line of the note content: scan for [[wikilink]] patterns; assign each unique wikilink an ordinal N (document order, 1-indexed); inject a styled anchor glyph [N] (ratatui Span with color from LinkColors) immediately after the closing ]] of each wikilink occurrence. Dead links (wikilinks whose target is not in the index) render in red (ANSI red in 8-color, Color::Red in true-color) or with a '!' prefix in no-color mode: ![N]. Track the document-order list of (ordinal, page_title, is_dead, line_number) tuples as LinkMap — this structure is shared by the context pane, bridge column, and focus mode tasks. REQ-064, ADR-017.
